title: Shivo Labs Hub
& Products
copy.lead: Besides client work, Shivo Labs builds its own software. Most of it runs inside the Shivo Labs Hub on Windows, iPhone and Android.

products.name: Hub
products.line: All Shivo Labs Apps in One Place
products.text: One app that holds every Shivo Labs tool. Updates install automatically.

products.name: AI
products.text: Ask questions, write and edit documents, and write code. Works with the files on your computer.

products.name: Chat
products.text: Message your team, friends and family one to one or in groups, and share photos and files. Works on phone and computer.

products.name: Cloud
products.text: Keep your files in one place and open them on your phone or computer.

products.name: Beam
products.text: Send photos, videos and documents from an iPhone to a Windows computer.

products.name: Mirror
products.text: Show your iPhone screen on a Windows computer without a cable, for presentations or screen recording. AI agents can see the screen too, so they can find and fix problems in your app.

products.name: iPhone App Signing
products.line: Build and Install iPhone Apps on Windows
products.text: Build, install and update your own iPhone apps from a Windows computer over Wi-Fi, and renew them before they expire. No Mac needed.

products.name: TV
products.text: A clean home screen for your TV without the preinstalled apps you never use. It shows your apps, recent shows and inputs, adds extra smart features, and turns your phone into a smart remote.

products.name: Camera
products.text: Take photos with film-style colour, using looks we made ourselves.

products.name: Website Insights
products.text: See how many people visit your website, where they come from and which pages they read. No cookies, and bots are filtered out.
